## Topics
- Why visualize?
- Aesthetics, geoms, and layers in ggplot2
- Mapping vs. setting
- Faceting

## Learning objectives
By the end of this week you should be able to:

- Build a ggplot layer by layer
- Map variables to color, shape, and size
- Use facets to compare subgroups

## Data
NHANES: BMI, blood pressure, age, sex
